scope.browser: Same private cumulative Idea02 diagnostic headless shell in every profile

profiles.seeded: Application source compiled without execution in donor; normal streaming enabled.
profiles.serial: Same seeded donor; opt-in main-thread classic ScriptResource URL match disables streaming before response. Final compilation uses full decoded response source and ScriptOrigin through ordinary V8.

scope.timing: Owner startup through observed natural descendant drain; includes application services, runner, browser/donor preparation and cleanup. Seeded and serial modes each serialize their exact source manifest; ordinary does neither.
scope.policy: Original test/helper bodies, HTTP/outcome contracts, same browser/driver/launch flags, fresh contexts, no retry or skip, trace/video/screenshots off.
scope.resources: Each sequential cell has four CPU quota cores, 8 GiB memory, zero swap and same priority.
scope.instrumentation: Original-parent initial exec stop then detach and bounded native diagnostics; no enabled startup trace. Suppression decisions do not count removed background tasks.

functionalEvidence.scope: Both applications pass direct trusted-input and fresh storage/global controls. Source text, origin offset and host-options mismatches compile the original response without seed reuse after streaming suppression. The original corpus passes ordinary, seeded and serial modes at one/four workers.
functionalEvidence.scopeLimit: Focused mechanism/fallback checks, not exhaustive redirects, manifest validation, modules, workers, GC, crashes or public conformance.

limits: Request intervals include queueing, IPC, browser/application waits and cleanup; they do not isolate CPU, critical subphases or removable work.
Per-method unions can overlap and must not be summed as exclusive wall shares.
Instrumentation changes Promise scheduling and exit work; no comparative speed acceptance.
Worker profile window excludes prior worker startup and outer fixture/runner phases. Process linkage is observed worker-to-guardian-to-original driver; not exhaustive resource admission.
phaseAttribution.decision: Prioritize page navigation work for TodoMVC and action path work for SVGOMG; page/context creation alone is not the largest interval category. Further compilation experiment specifically tests whether suppressing duplicate streaming preparation can reduce navigation work while retaining exact-source ordinary cache lookup.

provenance.scope: Separate diagnostic campaign preceding the streaming follow-up.

acceptance.comparison: serial elapsed <=0.8 times both ordinary and seeded-streaming controls in each order for the same application/worker cell
acceptance.resourceLimit: 4 CPU, 8GiB, zero swap per sequential cell
acceptance.uncertainty: Two observations per cell are a prioritization screen, not confidence bounds; sampled custody is not final resource admission.

interpretation.decision: Do not adopt or repeat this unchanged composition as a large-gain route. Tested patches and evidence are retained; the pre-application-compilation browser is restored.
interpretation.mechanism: Each deferred application compilation records a matching suppression decision and non-streaming ordinary compilation with exact source/origin/options, same inherited shared-function identity and explicit cache hit. The seeded control uses streaming.
limits: No cell reaches the 20% threshold against both controls in both orders.
SVGOMG single-worker deferred/seeded ratio is approximately 1.277 in the forward block; reverse is approximately 1.009. Preserve these observations without attributing a universal slowdown.

The marker records policy selection before response/redirect handling. It does not prove a background task would otherwise have started, quantify parse work removed or authorize execution of seed bytes.
Two reversed observations per cell on a shared host do not establish confidence bounds. Sampled custody is not exhaustive resource accounting.
No stock-browser/Playwright speed ratio or majority-scenario 2× result is established.

retainedFailures.currentBuildAndCampaigns: No failed build or workload attempt in this streaming follow-up.
retainedFailures.predecessors: Application-code donor compiler and missing-driver foundation failures remain separate in the predecessor record.

restoration.functionalControlScope: Six original successful browser exits and twelve fresh application contexts in ordinary, virgin-donor and obsolete-flag modes. Obsolete application flags point to a nonexistent manifest; no application-compilation markers occur.
restoration.preservation: Both tested prototype runtime versions, source patches, preimages and original observations remain archived privately.

sourceReview.status: No blocking source-substitution or thread-ownership defect found in scoped independent review; no workloads rerun by reviewer.
sourceReview.finding: Private header's observation-only description was stale. Header and behavior-changing prototype are now removed from the active checkout; historical snapshots retain the finding.
sourceReview.diagnosticLimits: Initial-URL policy decisions are capped per process/manifest entry. They do not prove avoided tasks or cache hits. Off-thread code-cache consumption remains available. This corpus has one manifest entry per run and requires separate final compilation, cache/SFI, source/metadata and donor-child joins.
